subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this memory-core recovery PR require redacted real Gateway/provider outage proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate based on the deterministic manager-level regression?
rationale: The source fix looks appropriate, but the contributor explicitly states they do not have a live Gateway/Ollama outage harness and repository policy treats external PR real-behavior proof as a merge gate.

options.title: Require real recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search fallback, primary recovery, and successful after-recovery search before merge.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression as sufficient and own the remaining live-provider uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require real recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search fallback, primary recovery, and successful after-recovery search before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history in the memory manager/provider-state owner boundary this proof decision concerns.
